# AgentShield

> Deterministic AI Agent Security & Governance Framework aligned with the OWASP 2026 Top 10 for LLM & Agentic Applications.

- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/
- Interactive Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/studio.html
- OWASP 2026 Benchmark: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/proof.html
- Defense Matrix: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/rules.html
- Documentation: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/docs.html
- Full LLM Context: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agentshield/llms-full.txt
- Source & Releases: https://github.com/codesphere-u/agentshield

## Core Subsystems
- `PromptInjectionDetector` (`LLM01:2026`, `LLM08:2026`): Direct override, ChatML delimiters, Base64/Hex decoded payloads, zero-width steganography.
- `AgentShieldPolicy` (`ASI02:2026`, `LLM06:2026`): Declarative `allow` / `deny` / `require_approval` rules + deep inspectors for shell chaining, path traversal, cloud metadata SSRF, and SQLi.
- `DataLeakageDetector` (`LLM02:2026`, `LLM05:2026`, `LLM07:2026`): Redacts API keys, PEM keys, JWTs, DB URIs, SSNs, Luhn credit cards, XSS payloads, and canary tokens.
- `AuditLedger`: Append-only SHA-256 hash-chained log with `verify_integrity()`.
